title: Healer Message Envelope v1
description: Common envelope wrapping every message exchanged between the Control Plane and an Agent.

message_id.description: Unique id for this message, used for logging/idempotency.

type.description: Message type, selects which payload schema applies.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp the message was created.

payload.description: Message-type-specific body; validated against the schema named for `type`.
